results.note: Kyiv Independent (updated 11 Nov 19:53 UTC) reports the second day of trilateral Ukraine-Russia-US talks concluded in Abu Dhabi on 11 Nov, and The Moscow Times (11 Nov) reports a final-day session of just under two hours with Kushner and Witkoff mediating.

Kyiv Independent (11 Nov 14:54 UTC) quotes Umerov, on the record, saying the talks agreed a large-scale prisoner exchange, and Medinsky confirming a fundamental agreement on a POW exchange; both statements came on 11 Nov, inside the window.

The Air Force's first morning summary on Telegram for the night of 11 Nov (from 18:00 on 10 Nov) reports 163 strike UAVs (Shahed incl. 91 jet-powered, Gerbera, S8000 Banderol/Dan-T and Parodiya decoys) plus one Kh-59/69 missile, below the 180 threshold.

UN News (11 Nov) reports that Guterres's address to the Antalya Leaders' Summit proposed a Climate Justice Compact to 'accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels', and quotes him saying 'Fossil fuels must go the way of the dinosaurs'; the AA text carried by NTV also quotes his call to accelerate the phase-out of fossil fuels.

NTV carries Anadolu Agency's extensive, largely verbatim quotes of Erdoğan's 11 Nov opening speech, and Hürriyet Daily News and Kıbrıs Genç TV reported it too; none contains 'fosil yakıt' (in NTV's text every 'fosil' mention belongs to Guterres or Lula). The full tccb.gov.tr transcript was unreachable, so the outcome rests on the AA text, not the official transcript.

Al Jazeera/AFP (10 Nov, updated 13:59 UTC) and Xinhua report that Iran's Foreign Ministry on Tuesday 10 Nov issued a statement that 'categorically rejects' France's 'baseless and one-sided accusations' over the fridge cyberattacks, which is inside the window.

Reports from 10-11 Nov (Iran International, Al Jazeera, Xinhua, Korea Times) cover France summoning Iran's ambassador and Iran's written denial, but none reports Iran summoning France's ambassador or head of mission in the window; a targeted search found only Iranian summonses from earlier months.
Commission press release IP/26/2407, dated 11 Nov 2026, says the Commission 'today' presented its Proposal for a Digital Fairness Act together with a revision of the CPC Regulation.

Press release IP/26/2407 (11 Nov) says the proposed CPC Regulation revision gives the Commission direct powers to investigate large-scale cases, with fines of up to 6% of a company's worldwide annual turnover.

ČTK report (via oEnergetice.cz, 11 Nov 2026 10:55) says the Chamber budget committee on 11 Nov supported the government's refinery windfall-tax bill without adopting any amendments; psp.cz not checked directly.

ČTK report (via oEnergetice.cz, 11 Nov 2026 10:55) says the budget committee adopted no amendments to the refinery-tax bill (STAN's importer amendment was rejected), so no extension to banks or other sectors.

ČTK (11 Nov 2026 10:48, updated 12:40) reports party representatives told journalists Prague will be governed by a STAN, Spolu and Praha sobě coalition with Hlaváček as mayor, including council seat split 5-4-2.
ČTK (11 Nov 2026 10:48) reports the announced final Prague coalition is STAN, Spolu and Praha sobě, with Praha sobě getting two council seats.

ČTK's media-funding dossier and searches show no statement by Babiš, Schillerová, Klempíř, Okamura or Macinka on 10-11 Nov 2026 that the model will include voluntary payments; Babiš's voluntary-fee remarks date from 26-31 Oct, outside the window.
Siemens Energy's Q4/FY2026 earnings release dated 11 Nov 2026 reports fiscal 2026 revenue of EUR 44,243 million (converted to 44.243 EUR bn; +15.5% comparable).
Siemens Energy's earnings release of 11 Nov 2026 guides fiscal 2027 comparable revenue growth of 14% to 16% (midpoint 15%, above 13%).
CSG's 9M 2026 Trading Statement of 11 Nov 2026 (investors.csg.com) reports 9M revenue of EUR 4,761m (headline 'EUR 4.8bn'); value converted from EUR million.
CSG's 9M 2026 Trading Statement of 11 Nov 2026 states 'FY 2026 revenue guidance between EUR 7.4 to EUR 7.6bn is reaffirmed', so the top was not raised.

ADVFN and Reuters (Irish Times) on 11 Nov 2026, citing easyJet's results announcement, report the Court Meeting approved the scheme with 97.07% in value and 83.29% in number, and the General Meeting resolution passed with 96.67%.
ČTK (11 Nov 2026 14:10), citing the Finance Ministry's Cenový věstník issued that day, reports the Thursday 12 Nov diesel cap at 45.87 CZK/l; the mf.gov.cz page did not render for the reader.

gCaptain (12 Nov) reports UKMTO said the tanker Dominica Prosperity was struck by a projectile at about 18:00 UTC on 11 Nov (22:00 Gulf time) 14 nm NW of Ras Al Khaimah, and JMIC's 12 Nov advisory lists the NCC Fajr struck in the Strait of Hormuz at about 02:00 UTC on 11 Nov; both fall in the 11 Nov Gulf-time window.

Breaking Defense (10 Nov) reports the House voted 211-204 on 10 Nov to refer Rep. Massie's Hegseth impeachment resolution to the Judiciary Committee, a recorded vote on a motion to refer inside the window (Political Wire, 10 Nov, reports the same); clerk.house.gov was not opened.
Breaking Defense (10 Nov) reports the resolution was referred to the Judiciary Committee by 211-204 on 10 Nov, so no article of impeachment was adopted on 10 or 11 Nov.

Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO, with Colette Kress as interim CEO, was announced on 12 Nov (Wikipedia Current events for 12 Nov citing AFP and Reuters; NYT and MarketWatch live coverage from 12 Nov 19:00 GMT), after the 10-11 Nov window closed.

NBC News (12 Nov 10:32 ET) reports Rep. Mast said Huang has agreed to brief lawmakers, and TechCrunch's timeline (13 Nov) records that on 11 Nov Huang had still not responded and Moolenaar threatened a subpoena, so the on-record confirmation came after the 11 Nov 23:59 ET window closed.

TechCrunch's scandal timeline (13 Nov) and ABC News (10-11 Nov) mention only the 5 Nov Mast/Moolenaar/Crawford letter, subpoena threats on 10-11 Nov and a Neal/Wyden letter addressed to Commerce Secretary Lutnick; no new congressional letter to Nvidia or Huang dated 10 or 11 Nov was reported.

REData peninsular daily Demanda read 14 Nov 05:05 CET (last update 13 Nov 07:56) gives 646,796.9 MWh for 11 Nov vs 675,411.9 MWh for 4 Nov, a change of -4.24%, at or below -3.0%; the general strike went ahead on 11 Nov (Ara, energias-renovables).

REData peninsular daily Demanda read 14 Nov 05:05 CET (last update 13 Nov 07:56) gives 646,796.9 MWh for 11 Nov vs 675,411.9 MWh for 4 Nov, a change of -4.24%, not as low as -6.0%; the strike itself took place on 11 Nov.

Al Jazeera (10 Nov) reports Trump only signalled positive momentum after meeting the Qatari PM, and Anadolu (10 Nov) reports Iran denied any talks or planned Qatar meeting; no on-record US statement in the 10-11 Nov window naming a date or venue for a US-Iran meeting was found.
